fact: The 2024-2026 national open government action plan lists the creation of an open data portal among the government's initiatives since joining the OGP and, under commitment 6, speaks of the Côte d'Ivoire Open Data portal as running and to be enriched with datasets; it names no running body and does not tie the portal to an open data policy, and it gives no date for the portal, so the plan's publication date of 2025-01 is used.
system: portail Open Data de la Côte d'Ivoire

fact: The OGP/IRM page reports that the Government Information and Communication Centre (CICG) launched the open data portal data.gouv.ci under the 2016-2018 action plan, and that after training the Ministry in charge of Petroleum and Renewable Energies published around 50 new datasets on it by June 2020 (document dated 2020 as inferred; no earlier launch date given).
